text: European lawyers may advise clients to incorporate at home simply because those lawyers do not want to deal with the courts and lawyers of another Member State, which suppresses cross border incorporation independently of statute quality.
citation: Christian Kirchner, Richard W. Painter, Wulf A. Kaal, Regulatory Competition in EU Corporate Law after Inspire Art Unbundling Delaware's Product for Euro (2004). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=617681

isBasedOn.name: Regulatory Competition in EU Corporate Law after Inspire Art Unbundling Delaware's Product for Euro

abstract: European lawyers thus may advise clients to incorporate at home simply because these lawyers do not want to deal with the courts and lawyers of another Member State.

value: European legal education and practice, where procedural differences across Member States are large
